name: Mortis (Corpse in the Monster) — 1 Basic — Cold of the Grave

system.description: The dead feel no pain, and with this power you extend the same numbing chill to yourself. Expend one Willpower Trait. Your body and mind become unnaturally cold. You are unaffected by wound penalties, and you gain a free retest against all attempts to manipulate your emotions; others receive a free retest on your attempts to manipulate their emotions. This chill does not reach the Beast — you still frenzy under the same provocation. Cold of the Grave lasts for one scene.
